ἡμιτύβιον [ῡ], τό,
A.linen cloth, towel, napkin, Sapph. 116 , Hp. Art. 37 , Ar. Pl. 729 ; of a kind of material, Michel 832.23 (Samos, iv B.C.). (Egypt. acc. to Poll. 7.71 :—in codd. sts. ἡμιτύμβιον , as in Aret. CD 1.3 , v.l. in
Lib. Decl. 26.42 , which is interpr. by Suid. , a half (i.e. small) grave; but prob. this form is due to the copyists, who wished to find a meaning in the word.)
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
